docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The second volume of Ray’s history: the iatro-chemical period, the Rasaratnasamuccaya and other texts, metals and their working, with chapters by B. N. Seal.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Wellcome Library, London; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: A history of Hindu chemistry from the earliest times to the middle of the sixteenth century, A.D · Ray, Prafulla Chandra, 1861-1944. n 84206283 · 1907, 600 scanned pages. Published 1909; Praphulla Chandra Ray died 1944 and Brajendranath Seal 1938; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
